Prospect Subscription.instructions: Estimate the probability that this one representative prospect starts a paid subscription within 30 days of starting its trial. Use the supplied engagement, purchase approval, competing tools, and historical evidence. Do not simply copy the historical conversion fraction. Return a single-trial Bernoulli success probability; the application will calculate the cohort Binomial distribution locally.

criteria.true: The prospect starts a paid subscription within 30 days of its trial start, including day 30.
criteria.false: The prospect does not start a paid subscription within 30 days of its trial start.
